selectedFunctions.label: Yamato Protocol borrow ETH/CJPY position
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; no persistent runtime attestation, underwriting/backing, claim eligibility, financial safety, liquidity, successful execution or complete-workflow assurance. Existing grants, policies, pause overlays and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Official Ethereum EIP1967 UUPS root 0x02fe72b2e9ff717ebf3049333b184e9cd984f257 currently resolves to YamatoV4 0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838. Etherscan reports current implementation Exact Match; Blockscout fully_verified=true, partial=false, verified_twin=null; implementation has no further proxy target. No synthetic Sourcify exact_match or persistent runtime attestation is claimed.

All six selected methods use fixed financial module interfaces and pass msg.sender as owner/payer/reward receiver. No arbitrary target/payload, permit, role grant, wallet signature or backend signing method is added. Dependencies are governance-mutable and independently upgradeable; current action-module implementations/full source are retained, but not full dependency runtime/safety attestation.

deposit() credits caller native ETH collateral and sends msg.value to Pool; creates caller pledge if absent. Nonempty pledge must reach collFloor=1e17wei (0.1ETH). Deposit, borrow and withdrawal obey same-block flash locks; even separate same-block transactions may revert. Only deposit is payable; every other selected method requires zero native value. No raw shared-pool prefunding workaround is used.

borrow(grossAmount) adds gross CJPY debt to caller pledge; requires existing pledge, after-debt ICR>=13000 per10000 (130%), positive fee and net amount. Fee=floor(grossAmount*FR(afterICR)/10000); only gross-fee is minted to caller, fee minted to redemption/sweep reserve. Linked PledgeLib FR ranges400 to10 per10000 with branch-specific integer rounding. No min-net-output, max-fee or deadline exists.

ETH quantities are wei and CJPY quantities18decimals; ETH/CJPY price is18-decimal fixed point and ICR per10000. Conversion/fee division rounds down. Redemption explicitly absorbs small collateral dust only within requested currency budget. Collateralization checks do not guarantee solvency, backing, fiat peg or principal value.

repay(amount) requires positive amount <= caller CJPY balance and own outstanding debt; CurrencyOS burns caller CJPY and reduces own/total debt. Actual deployed CJPY uses onlyCurrencyOS _burn(to,amount), not transferFrom: selected financial methods require no token allowance and add no generic token-burn capability. repay and withdraw have no root whenNotPaused; deposit/borrow/redeem/sweep do. Explorer paused=false is dated observation, not live assurance.

withdraw(amount) sends ETH only to caller from Pool; checks own/total collateral and same-block lock, pre-withdraw ICR strictly>MCR and post-withdraw ICR>=MCR. Remaining nonempty pledge must have0.1ETH; full exit permitted with zero debt/remaining collateral. No delayed withdrawal queue/claim exists; ranked queues are internal financial accounting.

redeem(maxAmount,false) burns at most caller-requested CJPY against ranked eligible undercollateralized pledges, up to50 pledges; can partially fill or revert without eligible positions. Integer-price conversion determines actual ETH;99% principal ETH plus1% gas-compensation ETH both go to caller. No min-output/deadline exists.

redeem(amount,true) is public fixed protocol-reserve redemption: source ignores amount and uses current redemptionReserve; burns pool CJPY, sends99% ETH to feePool and1% ETH gas reward to caller. Caller cannot choose payer/recipient. sweep() burns pool CJPY reserve to settle zero-collateral bad debt up to50 pledges, paying floor(actualSwept*GRR/100) CJPY reward to caller. No guaranteed reward or unrestricted asset sweeping authority.

Retained current dependency source: DepositorV3, BorrowerV2, RepayerV3, WithdrawerV3, RedeemerV5, SweeperV3, CurrencyOSV3, PoolV2 and CJPY. Actions link PledgeLib0x25026b8e547500c57ba63596de177da0808aad07; full library source is retained in verifier inputs, but linked runtime, price-feed/score/priority registries and legal/financial safety are not independently attested. No direct dependency-address capabilities are added.

Redemption explicitly absorbs small collateral dust only within requested currency budget. Collateralization checks do not guarantee solvency, backing, fiat peg or principal value.

repay(amount) requires positive amount <= caller CJPY balance and own outstanding debt; CurrencyOS burns caller CJPY and reduces own/total debt. Actual deployed CJPY uses onlyCurrencyOS _burn(to,amount), not transferFrom: selected financial methods require no token allowance and add no generic token-burn capability. repay and withdraw have no root whenNotPaused; deposit/borrow/redeem/sweep do. Explorer paused=false is dated observation, not live assurance.

withdraw(amount) sends ETH only to caller from Pool; checks own/total collateral and same-block lock, pre-withdraw ICR strictly>MCR and post-withdraw ICR>=MCR. Remaining nonempty pledge must have0.1ETH; full exit permitted with zero debt/remaining collateral. No delayed withdrawal queue/claim exists; ranked queues are internal financial accounting.

redeem(maxAmount,false) burns at most caller-requested CJPY against ranked eligible undercollateralized pledges, up to50 pledges; can partially fill or revert without eligible positions. Integer-price conversion determines actual ETH;99% principal ETH plus1% gas-compensation ETH both go to caller. No min-output/deadline exists.

redeem(amount,true) is public fixed protocol-reserve redemption: source ignores amount and uses current redemptionReserve; burns pool CJPY, sends99% ETH to feePool and1% ETH gas reward to caller. Caller cannot choose payer/recipient. sweep() burns pool CJPY reserve to settle zero-collateral bad debt up to50 pledges, paying floor(actualSwept*GRR/100) CJPY reward to caller. No guaranteed reward or unrestricted asset sweeping authority.

Retained current dependency source: DepositorV3, BorrowerV2, RepayerV3, WithdrawerV3, RedeemerV5, SweeperV3, CurrencyOSV3, PoolV2 and CJPY. Actions link PledgeLib0x25026b8e547500c57ba63596de177da0808aad07; full library source is retained in verifier inputs, but linked runtime, price-feed/score/priority registries and legal/financial safety are not independently attested. No direct dependency-address capabilities are added.

# Yamato Protocol

Yamato Protocol is a crypto-asset overcollateralized stable coin issuance protocol. V1 allows the issuance of CJPY (“Convertible JPY”, a Japanese Yen equivalent coin) using ETH as collateral.

[Official site (English)](https://app.yamato.fi/#/?lang=en)

## What is Yamato Protocol？

Yamato Protocol <https://app.yamato.fi/#/?lang=en> is a decentralized and non-custodial CDP platform developed by DeFiGeek Community Japan <https://defigeek.xyz/en/>

CJPY serves as an ETH overcollateralized stablecoin designed to maintain a peg to the Japanese Yen. In the future, the Yamato protocol will expand to encompass various tokens as collateral, and a diverse range of fiat stablecoins will be introduced, initially including USD and EUR pegs.

## 1 CJPY ＝ 1 JPY peg mechanism

The CJPY is soft-pegged by **game theory** to be equivalent to 1 JPY.

{% hint style="info" %}
What is **game theory** (mainly Nash equilibrium)?\
The idea is that each side behaves either selfishly or rationally, leading to a targeted equilibrium point (in this case, 1 JPY peg). Incentives and other motivators are needed in the dynamics that always outweigh aggressive (destructive, irrational) behavior.
{% endhint %}

1. The minimum collateral ratio at the time of issuance is 130%, which means that 1CJPY can always be expected to be backed by collateral equal to or greater than 1 JPY.
2. 1CJPY can always be redeemed against collateral equivalent to 1 JPY.

### Force to repeg when the price is less than 1 JPY

* Demand to purchase CJPY to repay or redeem
  * Debt of 1 CJPY can be repaid for less than 1 JPY, which increases the demand for purchases in the market.
  * Since CJPY obtained for less than 1 CJPY can be exchanged for 1 JPY worth of collateral through redemption, demand for arbitrage-oriented purchases will increase.

### Force to repeg when the price is over 1 JPY

* Selling demand from CJPY issue in Yamato
  * 1 CJPY borrowed can be sold in the market for 1 JPY or more and demand for arbitrage-oriented sells will increase.
